name: agent-tools
description: Workflow and review plugins for Claude Code: external LLM CLI wrappers, compaction steering, temporary-file cleanup, and a build-pipeline orchestrator.

plugins.name: third-party-reviewers
plugins.description: Runs the Codex and Antigravity CLIs as reviewers from a mod: one tool call runs a review and returns its result, the status line shows its progress, a cancel stops the CLI, and the findings come back structured. Carries its own /codex and /antigravity skills.

plugins.name: better-compact
plugins.description: Steers every compaction, including automatic ones, with a brief that keeps goal, next step, files, decisions and state. A session.compact hook composes the instructions; once context runs high, a button above the prompt shows the percentage and runs /compact when clicked, so you compact before a long context eats into your usage limits and model performance.

plugins.name: orchestrated-build-flow
plugins.description: Drives a non-trivial build from brainstorming through spec, plan, and subagent execution, inserting Codex convergence checkpoints (spec red-team, plan-review, diff-review) with receipt-gated, resumable phase transitions.

plugins.name: cys
plugins.description: Tracks the temporary files Claude creates and asks it to clean them up at the end of each turn. CYS never deletes anything itself.
